label.description: Shown as the option label in the interview

description.description: Shown as the option description in the interview

requires.description: axis -> allowed options. This fragment is only offered when every listed axis holds one of the listed values.

implies.description: axis -> single option. Pins a later axis and removes its question entirely.

conflicts.description: Fragment ids that cannot co-exist with this one.

traits.description: Free-form facts other fragments and templates may branch on.

vars.description: Template variables, exposed under the axis namespace (e.g. orm.schema_dir). Arrays of strings are allowed for bullet lists consumed by <% each %>.

agent.description: Contributions to generated agent files, keyed by agent name. Scalar fields may only be set by the axis named as that agent's required_axis in slots.json; every fragment may contribute array fields, which concatenate in axis order.

provides.description: slot id -> path to the body file, relative to this fragment dir.

emit_as.description: canonical slot id -> filename to emit under. Preserves domain vocabulary (backend-service -> backend-appservice).

contributes.description: target -> path to a markdown section, relative to this fragment dir. '<slot>#<anchor>' is rendered first and injected into the owner body at <% sections.<anchor> %>. A bare '<slot>' appends to the end of the owner body. 'claude-md#<anchor>' feeds the CLAUDE.md template the same way.

hooks.description: hook name -> array of rules contributed to that generated hook script.

requires.description: Minimum versions of external tools this fragment's commands need, e.g. { "node": "22.22.3" }. Checked before any command runs, so an unmet requirement fails immediately with a clear message instead of halfway through a scaffold.

phase.description: 'post' (the default) writes the file after every scaffold command, so it can overlay what a CLI generated. 'pre' writes it before any command runs — for files a command itself depends on, such as the root workspaces package.json that `npm install --workspaces` needs.
